reasons.removed: the track was removed from Plex (tracks.removed_at), so no server has the copy jimbo-dj stored
reasons.not_in_library: the stored rating key isn't in jimbo-dj's tracks at all
reasons.no_snapshot: no snapshot of this server yet: press Refresh on SERVERS to read it (GET requests only)
reasons.no_path: No file to match by: Plex gives no path for the copy, or the server none for the item; the MusicBrainz and tag tiers found nothing either.
reasons.outside_roots: The file is outside the known music folders, so it has no file key; the MusicBrainz and tag tiers found nothing either.
reasons.not_on_server: No item on the other server has this file, MusicBrainz IDs or tags.
reasons.ambiguous: More than one candidate at the first tier that had any (or one candidate two copies want): traqfreq doesn't guess.
reasons.hidden_path: The server gives no real path (Navidrome without Report Real Path), so the file tier can't be used, and the MusicBrainz and tag tiers found nothing.
reasons.not_in_plex: An item no Plex copy matched: a file Plex doesn't list.
reasons.multi_part: Another part of a multi-part Plex copy (same folder, disc and track): Plex keeps only the first part's file, which is matched; this part is not.
